http-python-requests.name: Python requests client
http-python-requests.command:
python - <<'PY'
import requests

res = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:3100/v1/chat/completions', json={
  'model': 'local-fake-model',
  'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'ping'}],
})
print(res.status_code)
print(res.text)
PY
http-python-requests.evidenceNotes: Send one POST /v1/chat/completions via requests and capture status + returned model/execution metadata.

http-python-httpx.name: Python httpx client
http-python-httpx.command:
python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
import httpx

async def main() -> None:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        resp = await client.post('http://127.0.0.1:3100/v1/chat/completions', json={
            'model': 'local-fake-model',
            'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'ping'}],
        })
        print(resp.status_code)
        print(resp.text)

asyncio.run(main())
PY
http-python-httpx.evidenceNotes: Validate async HTTP call path and fake-provider response contract.

http-python-aiohttp.name: Python aiohttp client
http-python-aiohttp.command:
python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from aiohttp import ClientSession

async def main() -> None:
    async with ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.post(
            'http://127.0.0.1:3100/v1/chat/completions',
            json={
                'model': 'local-fake-model',
                'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'ping'}],
            },
        ) as response:
            print(response.status)
            print(await response.text())

asyncio.run(main())
PY
http-python-aiohttp.evidenceNotes: Validate async Python aiohttp compatibility for plain /v1 request profile.
